([[College Park, Georgia]]) | college = * [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont]] (2021–2022) * [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]] (2022–2025) | draft_year = 2025 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 56 | draft_team = [[Memphis Grizzlies]] | career_start = 2025 | years1 = {{nbay|2025|start}}–present | team1 = [[Golden State Warriors]] | highlights = * [[List of NCAA Division I men's basketball champions|NCAA champion]] ([[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2025]]) * [[Ohio Valley Conference|OVC]] All-Newcomer team (2022) }} '''William Richard''' (born December 24, 2002) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Golden State Warriors]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont Bruins]] and the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]]. He was drafted by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] with the 56th pick in the second round of the [[2025 NBA draft]]. ==Early life and high school career== Richard grew up in [[Fairburn, Georgia]] and attended [[Woodward Academy]].{{Cite web |date=April 8, 2025 |title=Former Woodward Academy standout Will Richard wins national championship with Florida |url=https://www.wsbtv.com/news/local/former-woodward-academy-standout-will-richard-wins-national-championship-with-florida/UYSVEGZUWBHMVJNW3VBXW6XLQI/ |access-date=April 9, 2025 |website=WSB-TV Channel 2 - Atlanta |language=en}} His senior season, he averaged 24.0 points, 8.8 rebounds, and 2.1 steals per game, and during his time at Woodward played on the varsity basketball team with current [[Utah Jazz]] center, [[Walker Kessler]]. He earned first-team All-State honors as a senior and finished his high school career with over 1,000 points and 90 wins. Richard was a key player on the Woodward Academy team that won the Georgia 4A State Championship during his junior year. He was ranked second in the state of Georgia for scoring per 32 minutes and was named to the GHSAA first-team All-State. Coming out of high school, he committed to playing [[college basketball]] for [[Belmont Bruins men's basketball|Belmont]].{{cite web |last1=Sugiura |first1=Ken |title=Woodward Academy grad Will Richard has become a transfer-portal magnet |url=https://www.ajc.com/sports/georgia-tech/woodward-academy-grad-will-richard-has-become-a-transfer-portal-magnet/UQI6XSVEM5EBPNR3D3TH4UH2W4/ |website=The Atlanta Journal-Constitution |access-date=March 8, 2025}} ==College career== ===Belmont=== In the first round of the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament]], Richard notched 22 points and eight rebounds in a loss to [[2021–22 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]].{{cite web |last1=Organ |first1=Mike |title=Belmont basketball's Will Richard transferring to Florida |url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/2022/04/09/richard-transferring-florida-gators-belmont-basketball/9529964002/ |website=The Tennessean |access-date=March 8, 2025}} As a freshman in 2021–22, he averaged 12.1 points and six rebounds per game while shooting 32.6 percent from three,{{cite web |last1=Redman |first1=Bob |title=High-profile Belmont transfer Will Richard goes in depth with why he chose Florida |url=https://guidetogreatergainesville.com/high-profile-transfer-will-richard-chooses-florida-gators/ |website=Guide to Greater Gainesville |access-date=March 7, 2025}} earning [[Ohio Valley Conference]] all-newcomer team honors. After the season, Richard entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].{{cite web |last1=Carroll |first1=Brandon |title=Scouting Report: Florida Gators Transfer Guard Will Richard |url=https://www.si.com/college/florida/basketball/florida-gators-basketball-transfer-portal-guard-will-richard-scouting-report |work=Florida Gators on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 7, 2025}} ===Florida=== Richard transferred to play for the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]].{{cite web |last1=Thompson |first1=Edgar |title=Coming off Will Richard’s game-winner, No. 5 Gators gear for Georgia |url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/2025/01/24/florida-gators-mens-basketball-georgia-bulldogs-sec-todd-golden-mike-white-will-richard/ |website=Orlando Sentinel |access-date=March 7, 2025}} In 2022–23, he made 30 starts out of 32 games played, averaging 10.4 points and 4.5 rebounds while shooting 39.8 percent from 3-point range in his first season as a Gator.{{cite web |last1=Brockway |first1=Kevin |title=Another Florida basketball guard testing NBA Draft waters on same day UF lands Top 50 commit |url=https://www.gainesville.com/story/sports/college/football/2024/04/17/florida-basketball-guard-will-richard-declares-for-nba-draft-with-option-to-return/73303186007/ |website=Gainesville Sun |access-date=March 7, 2025}} On February 24, 2024, Richard dropped 21 points and five threes in a win over [[2023–24 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]].{{cite web |last1=Brockway |first1=Kevin |title=How Will Richard lifted Florida basketball to win over Vanderbilt |url=https://www.gainesville.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2024/02/24/florida-gators-basketball-tops-vanderbilt-commodores/72626945007/ |website=Gainesville Sun |access-date=March 7, 2025}} During the 2023–24 season, he made 35 starts, averaging 11.4 points and 3.9 rebounds per game while shooting 34.5 percent from three.{{cite web |last1=Brockway |first1=Kevin |title=Starting guards Walter Clayton Jr., Will Richard returning to Florida basketball |url=https://www.gainesville.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2024/05/27/florida-basketball-guards-walter-clayton-jr-will-richard-returning-for-2024-25/73821502007/ |website=Gainesville Sun |access-date=March 7, 2025}} On December 29, 2024, Richard totaled 26 points, five rebounds, two steals and two assists in a win over [[2024–25 Stetson Hatters men's basketball team|Stetson]].{{cite web |title=Richard scores career-high 26 to boost No. 7 Florida to 12-0 |url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/2024/12/21/florida-gators-sec-basketball-todd-golden-walter-clayton-alijah-martin-stetson-hatters-ncaa-basketball/ |website=Orlando Sentinel |access-date=March 7, 2025}} On February 25, 2025, he notched 30 points in a loss to [[2024–25 Georgia Bulldogs basketball team|Georgia]].{{cite web |last1=Parker |first1=Cam |title=Will Richard Passes Horford, Noah on Florida's All-Time Scoring List |url=https://www.si.com/college/florida/basketball/will-richard-passes-horford-noah-on-florida-s-all-time-scoring-list-01jnbxcem1zg |work=Florida Gators on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=March 7, 2025}} On March 1, Richard put up 25 points on nine of 13 from the field in a win over [[2024–25 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]].{{cite web |last1=Thompson |first1=Edgar |title=No. 3 Gators ride Will Richard’s hot hand past No. 12 Texas A&M |url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/2025/03/01/florida-gators-mens-basketball-sec-texas-am-aggies/ |website=Orlando Sentinel |access-date=March 7, 2025}} In the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|national championship game]], Richard scored 18 points, including all four of his three-pointers in the first half, in a close, come-from-behind 65–63 win over [[2024–25 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]]. ==Professional career== On June 25, 2025, Richard was selected with the 56th overall pick by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] in the second round of the [[2025 NBA draft]]. He was later traded to the [[Golden State Warriors]], in exchange for the draft rights to the 59th and last pick ([[Jahmai Mashack]]), the draft rights to [[Justinian Jessup]] ([[2020 NBA draft|2020]] 51st pick), and a 2032 protected second-round pick.Adams, Luke.
